data.heading: Trekking with Summit Trails
data.subheading: What to expect on our guided mountain journeys.

items.question: How fit do I need to be?
items.answer: Our trips are graded from easy to challenging. If you can walk for five to six hours on uneven ground, most itineraries are suitable.

items.question: What gear is provided?
items.answer: We supply tents, sleeping mats and group cooking equipment. You bring boots, a sleeping bag and personal layers.

items.question: Are guides certified?
items.answer: Every lead guide holds a mountain leader award and current wilderness first aid certification.

items.question: What if the weather turns?
items.answer: Safety comes first. We adjust routes or turn back, and we offer a rebooking credit on any cancelled departure.
